# awscc_cases_case (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Cases::Case



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the case.
- `case_id` (String) A unique identifier of the case.
- `customer_id` (String) The full customer profile ARN for the case.
- `domain_id` (String) The unique identifier of the Cases domain.
- `tags` (Attributes List) A list of tags for the case. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `template_id` (String) A unique identifier of a template.
- `title` (String) The title of the case.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.
